# MatAnyone 2 source

The `matanyone2` package is copied without modification from the official project:
https://github.com/pq-yang/MatAnyone2

Revision: `0079197acd6d16a741f71558809c06c586c579e0`.
Only the inference/model/config/utility package is included (about 170 KB), not
the upstream demos, sample assets, Git history or development environments.

See `MatAnyone2-LICENSE.txt` for S-Lab License 1.0 (non-commercial use conditions).
Vendoring keeps checkpoint inference independent of network/package downloads.
